security_fixes: CVE-2026-13719 (GHSA-46f2-3vm3-9h7j), medium, CVSS 4.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L, CWE-200: the alert-rules list API dropped the folder restriction when the caller's readable-folder set was empty and returned every alert rule in the org (rule configuration only, no datasource credentials); from 13.1.0 any user can trigger it with a folder filter. grafana.com Fixed Versions: <12.3.0 unaffected, fixed >=12.4.12, >=13.0.10, >=13.1.7, >=13.2.3, so 13.2.2 is affected and 13.2.3 fixed (matches the early return added in pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning/alert_rules.go in the v13.2.2...v13.2.3 compare). Repo reachability: by the advisory text the request path is open to any user, including the anonymous Viewer that ecosystem-grafana.ini enables (not exercised here), but there is no payload: the org holds no Grafana-managed alert rules (the alerting provisioning directory does not exist, per the server log; the Alertmanager datasource sets handleGrafanaManagedAlerts: false). Sources: https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-13719 ; https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-46f2-3vm3-9h7j ; https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/v13.2.3/CHANGELOG.md

CVE-2026-13720 (GHSA-9q62-r26p-xcjv), medium, CVSS 5.4 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L, CWE-285: an Editor can set file-provisioning provenance annotations (grafana.app/managedBy, managerId, sourcePath) when creating a dashboard through the dashboard API, so it appears file-provisioned and admins cannot update or delete it (same org, no data exposed). Fixed Versions: <12.0.0 unaffected, fixed >=12.4.12, >=13.0.10, >=13.1.7, >=13.2.3 (13.2.2 affected). Repo reachability: needs an Editor; the repo has none (anonymous org_role Viewer, allow_sign_up=false, one admin). The fix touches the file-provisioning metadata path the repo uses, and the smoke shows the provisioned dashboard still provisioned=true and read-only for the Viewer. Sources: https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-13720 ; https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9q62-r26p-xcjv

CVE-2026-81841 (GHSA-4jjr-w7m9-wx5q), medium, CVSS 5.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N, CWE-862: pausing a shared (public) dashboard did not revoke its access token for the frontend-bootstrap endpoints, exposing datasource configuration (including stored credentials of browser-access datasources) to anyone holding the link; deleting the shared dashboard does revoke it. Fixed Versions: <11.6.0 unaffected, fixed >=12.4.12, >=13.0.10, >=13.1.7, >=13.2.3 (13.2.2 affected). The ID is reported exactly as upstream lists it (CHANGELOG, GHSA record and grafana.com page all carry CVE-2026-81841). Repo reachability: needs a public-dashboard token that only an admin could have created; none is configured, and the repo's datasources are proxy-access with no stored credentials. Sources: https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-81841 ; https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4jjr-w7m9-wx5q
